usedFor: Each booked entry in Aarven shows up as a deal in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Aarven, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A deal gives sales a pipeline line to act on, with the values you map.

watchOut: “New Booking” in Aarven polls once a day for yesterday's bookings, so nothing reaches HubSpot the same day.
